review.reviewer_agent: independent read-only adversarial review (fresh general-purpose agent, eventmodeling renderer cohort, 2026-11-14, task a1616614c326e9b96)
review.note: Final verdict APPROVE after one re-review. The first pass returned REQUEST CHANGES on two MAJORs, both fixed in this family's validator. M1: is_dotted_name did not constrain the first character of each segment, so digit-led names ('1', '1A', 'A.1B', '[[B.2]]', 'data 1', a digit-led data key) drew; it is now a per-segment state machine requiring an identifier-start character. M2: an empty data block ('data D { }') drew; a block now requires at least one indent-2 entry before its closing brace (block_has_entry). Three MINORs were tightened in the same pass: an inline data block and a [[reference]] are each allowed at most once while ->> relations may still chain; a data entry allows only one optional trailing comma (the radar-style position-aware rule, so 'k: v,,' fails); and a data header must be followed by its own brace rather than be overwritten by another header or frame. The re-review ran 680,000+ fuzz/mutation cases against a strict grammar oracle: the v1-to-v2 differential is tightening-only with zero new accepts, all six corpus fixtures still draw with verbatim output and pinned shas, and no invariant is violated. The retained NITs (no required space between a name and its suffix, trim-based whitespace tolerance, and the over-broad ':::' substring gate) are fail-safe inherited shapes shared with the approved siblings and are unchanged per the blast-radius rule. The trim-before-colon frontmatter gate and printable-ASCII literal hardening are confirmed.
